gaps.sentence: They've postponed ___ the new bridge until spring.
They can't help ___ at his impression of the boss.
gaps.explanation: can't help + -ing = can't stop yourself: can't help laughing.

gaps.sentence: My parents wouldn't let me ___ out that late.
gaps.explanation: let takes the bare infinitive: let me go (no 'to').

gaps.sentence: I'm sorry for ___ so long to reply.
We expect ___ the results by Friday.
gaps.explanation: expect takes the to-infinitive: expect to receive.

gaps.sentence: He continued ___ as if nothing had happened.
gaps.explanation: continue takes -ing or to-infinitive. Both accepted.

gaps.sentence: Don't forget ___ the plants while we're away.
gaps.explanation: forget + to-infinitive = fail to do something you should do.

gaps.sentence: Despite ___ three times, he didn't give up.
